# Dictionary fixture

`kaikki-tigrinya.jsonl` is the Tigrinya dictionary snapshot used to verify the two-letter word bank, not approved curriculum.

- Source: [Kaikki.org Tigrinya dictionary](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Tigrinya/index.html), extracted from English Wiktionary by Wiktextract.
- [Original download](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Tigrinya/kaikki.org-dictionary-Tigrinya.jsonl), retrieved 17 November 2026.
- The source index reports extraction on 30 October 2026 from the 1 October 2026 dump.
- Dictionary-derived text is attributed to English Wiktionary contributors and Kaikki.org / Wiktextract under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The original file is retained unchanged for reproducible checks.
- The fixture contains 942 records and 917 distinct headwords. The review data groups 148 matching records into 142 distinct two-letter headwords; 32 are provisional picture candidates.
- Source checksum, entry URLs, contributor-history links, original transliterations and review status are preserved in `../../unit-2-content-review.json`.

All learner-facing content and image associations remain awaiting qualified native Tigrinya review. Passing a fixture check does not approve an entry.
